echam.routine: mo_cloud_micro_2m.f90::cloud_micro_interface WITH mo_cirrus.f90::xfrzmstr linked in (not the harness's abort-stub) at nic_cirrus=2 -- the end-to-end verification jax-gcm#1017 task 2 part 2b's lead asked for, beyond the bare-xfrzmstr harness (part 2a's hamcirrus.npz) and the bare-ham_IN_setup harness (hamfrz_M7.npz)

mode: cloud_micro_interface (same base harness as cloud2m_T63L47.npz/cloud2m_frz_T63L47.npz) with mo_cirrus.f90 real (not stubbed) and cloud_subm_1's stub extended with driver-set papnx_in/paprx_in/papsigx_in (mo_submodel_interface.f90, this copy only) so pascs/papnx/paprx/papsigx reach cloud_micro_interface exactly as mo_ham_freezing.f90::ham_IN_setup's own ld_het=.FALSE. branch would hand them to it

columns.pure_cirrus_supersaturated: 230 hPa, 210 K, RH_ice 1.8 (S_ice-1=0.8, above SCRHOM(210)~=0.563, the homogeneous threshold at this T -- see cirrus.py's _scrhom), moderate updraft (TKE 0.3), pascs 1e8 kg-1, no pre-existing ice: the base case this task's claim (b) needs (step-start supersaturation drives XFRZMSTR, not section 5's).
columns.pure_cirrus_with_preexisting_ice: Same level/supersaturation/aerosol as pure_cirrus_supersaturated, but with pre-existing ice (pxim1 5e-6, ICNC 5e7 m-3) already present: claim (a) needs this -- the depletion zapnx=max(1e-6*(papnx-icnc),1e-6) must see THIS column's own zicncq, not zero, for the two columns to differ as jcm predicts.
columns.cirrus_low_updraft: Same level/supersaturation/aerosol, TKE near 0 (updraft ~0): COOLR is small, so TAU is large and the growth/relaxation chain (xfrzhom's X root search) runs in a different regime.
columns.cirrus_high_updraft: Same level/supersaturation/aerosol, TKE 3 m2/s2 (strong updraft): COOLR large, TAU small.
columns.cirrus_no_aerosol_floor_control: Same supersaturated/updraft cell with NO aerosol (pascs=papnx=0): the nic_cirrus=2 candidate caps at 0 regardless of XFRZMSTR's own output, pinning ICNC at the icemin floor -- the #552 regression this whole task guards, as a control against the non-zero cells above.

harness.repository: private scratch copy (fortran_harness/echam_cloud2m), own copy extended with mo_cirrus.f90 real-linked, mo_submodel_interface.f90's papnx_in/paprx_in/papsigx_in, the driver's three extra records (magic 7944), and columns_cirrus2m.py/fortio_cirrus2m.py (own code), of jam-ice-953's/#1017 part 1's harness/echam_cloud2m
